notes.title: The 2.0 version of the game has been released, adding two new difficulty modes.
notes.notes:
From now on, you can choose the difficulty level in the TOLD GOD. The previous version defaulted to the initial "Investigator" difficulty level. This game has added a more challenging "Adventurer" difficulty level and a "Challenger" difficulty level that will immediately kill anyone who takes any damage. Moreover, in the newly added difficulty, players are unable to resurrect themselves in place.
Can only return to the lounge after death.

notes.title: Told god will launch a trial version! in the Steam Next Fest: October 2024
notes.notes:
Told god will launch a trial version! in the Steam Next Fest: October 2024
From October 14, 2024 (PT) to October 21, 2024 (PT), a trial version of the game will be released,
The trial version will include two game protagonists, Vincent and Afra, each with a portion of the game content, allowing players to experience two different gameplay modes. 
Welcome everyone to look forward to and support our game!
